description: Humanoid robotics development for the Unitree G1 platform, focusing on system engineering, simulation environments, safety architecture, and Physical AI pipelines.

achievements.text: Developing end-to-end humanoid robotics use cases for the Unitree G1: system engineering, digital twins, simulation-first validation, autonomy, interaction, manipulation, and real-robot deployment.
Built a G1 simulation environment demonstrating locomotion, workspace safety sectors, and basic manipulation; established an Isaac Sim-based sim-to-real development workflow.
Designed a robot-agnostic ROS 2/HAL architecture that decouples autonomy, interaction, simulation, and safety logic from robot-specific runtime adapters.

Implemented safety-oriented humanoid architecture: HARA, functional/technical safety concepts, safety wrappers, watchdogs, state estimation, command-rate adaptation, and risk-based emergency-stop logic.
Initiated SO101 arm development for synthetic-data generation, simulation-based collection, hardware calibration, and testing.
Building Physical AI workflows: multimodal demonstration collection, behavioral cloning, and ACT/SmolVLA training pipelines.
